ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous zones at distal tips; left lobe distal 50% is white; right lobe distal 30% features a large oval white patch. A distinct star-shaped white mark is positioned in the dark proximal region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 55 degrees and a bounding box depth relative to lobe height of approximately 20%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serration along trailing edge; right lobe exhibits three to four significant high-amplitude notches (irregular tissue voids); left lobe shows higher frequency, low-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curves extending from the median notch to the pointed distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous small circular high-contrast white spots distributed across black regions, with higher density on the right lobe distal margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white star-shaped mark consisting of intersecting linear segments on the proximal left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notches on the right lobe trailing edge suggesting tissue loss; unique star-shaped white mark on the central-left fluke area.
other_distinctive_markers: The star-shaped mark on the left fluke is a highly unique pixel cluster for individual identification.
